name: Pal Identity Contract
mission: Make each approved Fitness Pal a durable, independently voiced and remembered identity while preserving myChat and Fitness-Pals security boundaries.
unresolvedIdentityRule: Do not invent candidate ids, names, biographies, voices, or personalities for finalists that are not yet represented in source control. They remain non-activatable slots until their canonical identities are supplied.

personaIdentity.modelDefinitionRequirement: Every activated pal has its own generated model definition equivalent in role to myChat/Amanda.Modelfile; shared base weights are allowed but the persona system contract is not.

memory.migrationRule: Use myChat's explicit migration-ledger mechanism once that mechanism is terminal-green on main; do not introduce an ad-hoc schema initializer.

integration.fallback: Existing Fitness-Pals text Coach remains usable when persona service, voice, private profile, or myChat is unavailable.

rollout.name: Pal Identity Contract
rollout.purpose: Freeze persona identity, ownership, isolation, and activation rules.

rollout.name: Persona Registry and Model Renderer
rollout.purpose: Generalize Amanda's generated model definition into a persona registry and one generated model definition per activated pal.

rollout.name: Persona Memory Namespace
rollout.purpose: Migrate long-term memory ownership from profile-only to profile-plus-persona without cross-persona recall.

rollout.name: Distinct Living Voices
rollout.purpose: Bind independent voice profiles and speaking behavior to each activated persona.

rollout.name: Fitness-Pals Pal Adapter
rollout.purpose: Expose versioned persona discovery and turn-taking through the same-origin adapter while preserving text Coach fallback.

rollout.name: Embodied Pal Selection
rollout.purpose: Bind the approved finalist visuals to live persona sessions and user choice with accessible, responsive interaction.

observedBaselines.note: The myChat SHA is discovery evidence, not a frozen implementation base. Slice 2B must re-read then-current terminal-green myChat main.
